name: The Northern Pylon
summary: A curious traveler asks you to find the Northern Crystal Pylon in Un'Goro Crater. The rumors about the crystal pylons have caught their attention.

sections.title: A Northern Search
sections.body: In Un'Goro Crater, a traveler has heard stories about crystal pylons and wants to know if they are true. They ask you to find the pylon said to lie somewhere in the north.

faq.q: Who asks me to find the Northern Crystal Pylon?
faq.answer: J.D. Collie at Marshal's Refuge has heard stories about crystal pylons and asks you to locate the northern one.

faq.q: Where is the Northern Crystal Pylon?
faq.answer: It is somewhere in the northern part of Un'Goro Crater; you are asked to discover its location.

faq.q: Why am I looking for it?
faq.answer: The traveler wants to learn whether the stories about crystal pylons are true.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Northern Pylon
